note: BH-7505: the fly-pool project lease length a hub tick asks for when a Fly run could contest it (the project is placed fly, or was last tick and the row has just moved back). A renewer renews it every fifth of this while the tick runs and ends with the tick. A hub tick killed outright leaves the lease to run out, and a machine waits at most this long. 10..900 is the lease route's range. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_fly_hub_lease_ttl_s`.
